targets.title: Identification properties of recent production function estimators.
targets.evidence_quote: This paper replicates ACF simulation results in both a narrow and broader sense. First, we replicate their results by using the same procedure in the ACF setting. While the narrow replication yields results that are identical to those of ACF when we take the initial parameter values of estimation as the true values as in ACF, we also observe that their procedure 1 See also Gandhi, Navarro, and Rivers (2017) for related identification problems of the proxy variable approach in the production function estimatio n. 612 © 2019 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd. wileyonlinelibrary.com/journal/jae J Appl Econ. 2019;34:612–619. KIM ET AL. 613 yields a spurious minimum in the estimation, as discussed by ACF, when we add a grid search over different starting values that deviate from the true ones.

targets.outcome_reasoning: The exact simulation procedure reproduces its findings, but the main message is that apparently good estimation depends on initialization at true parameters and yields spurious minima with a broader search. This is a methodological simulation replication rather than reanalysis of original observed data; the special flawed category is the closest fit, with uncertainty about applying that vocabulary to simulations.
